_comment: Repo-health corpus: positives are scan/audit/scaffold intents over community, security, CI, and release conventions; negatives are sibling domains — change narration (git-toolkit), code quality (coding-principles), markdown stewardship (docs-steward). Release *automation* is positive here; release *notes* belong to git-toolkit.
positive: audit this repo's health and score it against best practice
what community files is this repository missing?
add a SECURITY policy to this open source repo
scaffold CONTRIBUTING and a code of conduct for the repo
pick the license and set up licensing conventions
make this open source repository top notch
harden the dependency supply chain for this repo
set up automation for the dependency updates in CI
level up our CI automation to OSS best practice
does this repo meet open-source community health standards?
first touch onboarding: scan what conventions this repo declares
score the repo's branch protection and release automation setup
negative: write a commit message for the staged refactor
draft release notes from the commits since the last tag
tidy the branch's commits into a reviewable history
audit the markdown formatting in the docs folder
lint the frontmatter in every doc page
fix the null-pointer bug in the session handler
check whether my pull request passes its merge gates
review this code change for design smells
open a PR with a description of these changes
add retry with backoff to the fetch layer
